mobile.activeSets.round: Part of a set's details line, after the bracket side's name: the round number within that side.
mobile.activeSets.tiebreak: Part of a set's details line: the set is a tiebreak played to split a tie.
mobile.communities.all: Heading on the Communities tab over every community the viewer does not follow, when a "Yours" group sits above it.
mobile.communities.home: Flag beside the viewer's home community in the Communities tab list.
mobile.community.boardTitle: Section heading on a community's screen; {game} is the game the board ranks.
mobile.community.wonBy: Part of a finished event's line on a community's screen, after the date; {winner} is the winning player.
mobile.event.entryFee: On a bracket's line on the event screen, after its game and entrant count: what entering costs. {price} is a formatted amount. Lower case because it follows a middle dot.
mobile.event.register: The button on the event screen that opens the registration form.
mobile.format.dateTbc: Shown in place of a date and time that is not known yet.
mobile.format.listAnd: Joins the last name onto a list of names, as in "A, B and C"; {head} is the names before the last, already joined with commas.
mobile.home.played: Beside a suggested community: how many of its events the viewer has played. The × reads as 'times'.
mobile.home.recentSet.a11y: Read by screen readers for one of the viewer's recent sets. {mine} and {theirs} are the two scores (or ?), the viewer's first.
mobile.home.trend: After the viewer's rating change: the period it covers. 88d is 88 days.
mobile.ladder.top: Under a rank on a community board: the share of the board the player is in the top of. {pct} is already a formatted number.
mobile.myEvents.entered: Heading of the list of events the reader has registered for.
mobile.myEvents.hosting: Heading of the list of events the reader hosts.
mobile.notifications.settings: Link at the top of the notifications screen to the notification settings screen.
mobile.pager.emptyPage: A paged list whose current page came back empty; the reader should go to the previous page.
mobile.privacy.appearance: Label of a switch on the phone's Privacy screen. On (the default), the language and date format picked on this phone are stored on it; off, they are forgotten when the app closes.
mobile.push.channel: Name of the app's notification channel in Android's system settings.
mobile.register.block.finished: Beside a bracket the reader has not entered: it is over, so it cannot be picked.
mobile.register.prefix.placeholder: Placeholder of the short box before the name: a sponsor or clan tag.
mobile.register.registering: The submit button while a registration is being sent.
mobile.run.pathStep: One step of the viewer's path through a bracket. {result} is W or L; draws it in bold.
mobile.scope.selected: Flag beside the community currently chosen in the community picker.
mobile.scope.unfollowNamed: Screen-reader name of the heart button on a followed community; {label} is the community's name.
mobile.sets.pager: Names what a paged list holds, spoken by screen readers in 'Previous page of sets' and 'sets, showing 1 to 50 of 120'.
mobile.standings.pager: Names what a paged list holds, spoken by screen readers in 'Previous page of standings' and 'standings, showing 1 to 50 of 120'.
mobile.standingsRow.games: Part of a standings row: games won and lost across the entrant's sets.
mobile.standingsRow.seed: Part of a standings row: the entrant's starting seed.
mobile.tabs.myRun: Bottom tab for the viewer's live tournament companion: what they play next, and where.
mobile.title.pairing: Header title of the screen where a doubles entrant picks or confirms a partner.
mobile.ui.pager.position: Between the Previous and Next buttons of a paged list: which items are shown, out of how many.
mobile.ui.pager.positionLabel: Screen-reader reading of a paged list's position; {label} names the list.
